recentItems.title: Grand Canyon flash flood: 1 dead, ~15 missing
recentItems.description:
One of the most famously arid national landmarks succumbed to deadly flash flooding over the weekend, leaving at least one person dead and more than a dozen unaccounted for as more rain is set to pummel Grand Canyon National Park in Arizona on Monday.

A 46-year-old man’s body was found near Crystal Rapids along the Colorado River, park officials said Sunday night. And about 15 people could be missing after “nearly all footbridges spanning Bright Angel Creek were destroyed, eliminating hiker access across the creek,” the National Park Service said.

CNN meteorologist Derek Van Dam explains the weather conditions in the area, and why the flash flood Sunday was so severe.

recentItems.title: Djokovic crashes out in US Open first round
recentItems.description: Novak Djokovic, the record 24-time Grand Slam champion, crashed out in the first round of the US Open after a five-set defeat to Mariano Navone. Djokovic appeared to struggle physically during the match, leading to questions about whether he may retire.
